name: Joe
text: I was getting ready to order new head light lens. Bennett asked if he could clean them so I let him. Bennett did a great job and saved me over 150$. I definitely would recommend his services.

name: Alivia
text: My headlights were so bad and foggy! Bennett came and did a fantastic job clearing them! He was super nice and super helpful! I can see so much better driving at night! Be sure check him out! 10/10 would definitely recommend!
